summary: Mineral County, MT 30-foot pole L-4 tower on the Lolo NF, built 1934, in ruins by 1992, listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.com says the tower was in ruins by 1992; the FFLA Montana list marks it gone.

events.note: Firelookout.com says the tower was built in 1934

evidence.supports: 30-foot pole L-4 tower, built 1934, in ruins by 1992
evidence.quote: This 30' pole L-4 tower, built in 1934, was in ruins by 1992.

evidence.supports: about 7 miles north-northeast of St. Regis

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says the tower was in ruins by 1992, while the FFLA list says Gone. The story reports both and keeps gone as the listed status.

notes_for_editor: Record status gone and kind tower are supported. Design, height and elevation were missing and are added from firelookout.com; the 30-foot figure is recorded as a pole length in design, not as height_m. No staffing, fire, access or visit information in any source, so those are left out. The firelookout.com photo caption (Fire Lookout Museum) has no image URL, so no photo was added. Two searches; three page reads (firelookout, Forest Lookouts, FFLA list). Name collision: us-mt-olson-peak-2 is a different tower (Helena NF, Lewis & Clark County, L-4 cab, firelookout olsonpeak369.html). That record's firelookout link is http://www.firelookout.com/mt/olsonpeak.html, which is this Mineral County page, so that link needs checking in data/towers/mt/us-mt-olson-peak-2.json.
